signup.displayNameHelp: This is the only detail we need. Any name you like works.
signup.privacyBody: FairShift keeps the records you add (shifts, documents, reports) so you can see and use them. Your employer cannot see your evidence documents. Safety reports follow the privacy mode you pick. We do not ask for a phone number, address or ID number, and we run no ads or analytics. Deleting an account is not available in this version yet.
